title: Whole Rotary Card File and Tally Counter Stepped Display
description: One complete static two-level office reception display, one new scene zero new independent models. One whole qualified four-blank-window tally counter stands separately on the low front-right surface, its readout facing the open front. Both complete source props retain all original geometry, normals, PBR material dictionaries, face assignments and internal hierarchies under unit-scale whole translations only. No crop, card or counter-part extraction, recolour, scale or repeat model count. Unlike the flat kitchen tool bay or a powered print-finishing bench, this is an open diagonal high/low arrangement of a ring-card file and a hand counter with no backsplash or enclosing wall. Only the continuous two-level plinth is new scene environment. Static blank administrative display only: no personal information, visitor records, verified reception workflow, counting or card retrieval, movement, load, stability, ergonomic fit, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
